ya10.3.2:10.1: sacchākāsi → sacchikaroti (bj) | sacchikarittha → PTS ūnaṁ (bj note) | aññātāvind → Br. inserts Yo aggaphalaṁ sacchikaroti, so cakkhund. parijānittha no ca aññātāvind. sacchikarittha. Yo aggaphalaṁ sacchākāsi, so cakkhundriyañ ca parijānittha aññātavindriyañ ca sacchikarittha. Yo vā pana aññātāvind. sacchikarittha, so cakkhund. parijānitthāti. (pts note)
ya10.3.2:25.1: puggalā → cha puggalā (bj: sīmu, PTS) | Cha → Br. Satta. (pts note)
ya10.3.2:26.1: anaññātaññassāmītindriyamūlakaṁ →  (bj, sya-all) | Āmantā → Br. inserts Yo aññind. bhāvittha, so aññātāvind. sacchikaritthāti? Yo aggaphalaṁ sacchikaroti, so aññind. bhāvittha, no ca aññātāvind. sacchikarittha. Yo aggaphalaṁ sacchākāsi, so aññindriyañ ca bhāvittha, aññātāvindriyañ ca sacchikarittha. Yo v. p. aññātāvind. sacchikarittha, so aññindriyaṁ bhāvitthāti? Āmantā. (pts note)
